BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain tracks the state of a party relationship with the bank from the in itial checks made during the establishment of a new party connection and subsequently maintained as necessary over the duration of the relationship. The checks and the main tenance requirements will vary by party type and jurisdiction. The checks cover bank s pecific and legal and regulatory considerations and may be updated based on a standard schedule or by request in specific circumstances.
